d.seg: इंस्टाग्राम पर कनेक्ट हो गए मेरे साथ हाँ हो जाऊँगी बट मैं आपको जानती नहीं हूँ ना अभी तो
d.tr: Connect with me on Instagram, yes, I will, but I don't know you yet.
d.ctx: The user asked where the expert was from, and the expert responded by suggesting connecting on Instagram. The user then agreed to connect but expressed hesitation.
d.j: The expert is proposing to connect on a named external app (Instagram) to continue the conversation.

d.seg: हाँ एक बार देख लो मेरी प्रोफाइल वहाँ सही लगे तो बात कर लेना वरना ब्लॉक कर देना
d.tr: Yes, check my profile once, if it seems right, then talk, otherwise block me.
d.ctx: Following the suggestion to connect on Instagram, the expert is giving instructions on how the user should proceed after viewing her profile.
d.j: The expert is directing the user to move the conversation to an external platform (Instagram) for further interaction.

d.seg: वैसे मैं मयूर भी है इंस्टाग्राम पर कनेक्ट हो गई हाँ हो जाऊंगी बट मैं आपको जा
d.tr: By the way, I am also on Instagram, I will connect, yes, I will, but I don't know you.
d.ctx: The expert is reiterating her presence on Instagram and agreeing to connect, while still stating she doesn't know the user.
d.j: The expert is confirming her presence on a named external app (Instagram) as a means to continue contact.
